title: Q-ULTRA-access-check-value-2: The tenant's own declared value metric out of bounds: iterate: change what the app does (access-check; verb iterate)
body:
**Owner:** executor
**Trigger:** essential variable `access-check:value` out of bounds (reading 0.0; limits 1.0 to None)
**Done check:** cmd:python3 -m foundation ultrastability --check
**Status:** open

ULTRASTABILITY-1 second-order step: iterate: change what the app does (access-check; verb iterate). A system with no measure that can be wrong cannot be improved. Read as the tenant's declared metric divided by its own declared target (ops/tenants/<slug>.json declared_metric, declared_target); 1.0 is on target.

size: M

**Closing probe:** `python3 -m foundation ultrastability --tick` reads `value` inside its bounds.
